about_short_description.short_description: Plasticity makes better natural language understanding open and accessible through simple APIs.

product.name: Natural Language Understanding API
product.description: An API that extracts entities, relationships, and context from unstructured text to enable natural language understanding.

product.name: Knowledge Graph
product.description: A queryable graph containing over 240 million real-world concepts, people, places, and things accessible via natural language queries.

product.name: Open Information Extraction
product.description: A tool that extracts nested subject-verb-object triples and relationships from text to represent information in structured form.

product.name: Intent Parsing and Slot Filling
product.description: An API that analyzes text to detect user intent and extract relevant information slots for conversational applications.

identifier.value: Part-of-Speech Tagging and Syntax Dependency Parsing

product.name: Part-of-Speech Tagging and Syntax Dependency Parsing
product.description: APIs that analyze sentence structure by tagging parts of speech and parsing syntactic dependencies in complex sentences.
